## TRA Timeline

#### Underlying TRA and 2006 Cendant separation

- 2005-02-22: WEX IPO TRA executed between Wright Express, Cendant, and Cendant Mobility Services (filed under WEX CIK, not Realogy)
- 2006-07-27: Cendant Separation and Distribution Agreement assigns 62.5% of Cendant's beneficiary interest to Realogy (with the Cartus portion); 37.5% stays with what becomes Avis Budget Group

#### Recurring TRA payments to Realogy

- 2008-Q2 to 2009-Q2: Trailing twelve-month payments of $12M / $9M / $6M as the 15-year amortization runs

#### Prepayment Agreement terminates Realogy's beneficiary interest

- 2009-06-26: WEX and Realogy execute Tax Receivable Prepayment Agreement (8-K Exhibit 10.1); $51M gross / approximately $49M net to Realogy; mutual release of Article III obligations for Realogy's 62.5% share only

## Explanation

The underlying Tax Receivable Agreement was executed on February 22, 2005 between Wright Express Corporation (WEX, the PubCo obligor), Cendant Corporation, and Cendant Mobility Services Corporation at WEX's IPO; WEX agreed to pay 85% of federal tax savings from the Section 754-style basis step-up in WEX's tangible and intangible assets arising from Cendant's disposition of WEX, with the step-up amortizing over 15 years. The 2006 Cendant Separation and Distribution Agreement passed 62.5% of Cendant's beneficiary interest (the Cartus portion) to Realogy; the remaining 37.5% stayed with the entity later renamed Avis Budget Group. Recurring payments to Realogy ran at $6-12M annually until June 26, 2009, when WEX and Realogy executed a Tax Receivable Prepayment Agreement (filed under Realogy's CIK as Exhibit 10.1 to an 8-K) settling Realogy's 62.5% interest for $51M gross / approximately $49M net and mutually releasing the parties from all further Article III obligations on that share; Apollo Investment Fund VI guaranteed certain Realogy indemnities. Realogy's beneficiary interest is therefore terminated; the residual 37.5% Avis Budget interest would need to be checked under that CIK and is out of scope here. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record and the obligor-side cross-reference to WEX CIK 0001309108.
